name: parse_cmdline_p_switch
desc: Searches an input string for the switch '/P' followed by a 4-digit hexadecimal value and stores the result.
details: Scans the input buffer pointed to by ES:DI for the switch '/P'. If located, it parses the next 4 hexadecimal digits into a 16-bit word using an external digit parser and stores the result at CS:[01B2h]. If the switch is not found or an invalid hex digit is encountered, 0 is stored instead.

params.name: cmdline
params.desc: Pointer to the command line buffer to scan

params.name: len
params.desc: Length of the command line buffer in bytes

ret.name: value
ret.desc: Parsed 16-bit hexadecimal value (also written to CS:[01B2h]), or 0 on failure

instrs.comment: Save registers, clear direction flag, and initialize result to 0
Scan input string for '/' character; exit if end of buffer is reached
instrs.label: scan_slash

instrs.comment: Check if character following '/' is 'P'; continue scanning if not
Skip 'P' and set up loop counter to parse 4 hexadecimal digits
Fetch next character and convert hex ASCII to numeric value; abort on error
instrs.label: parse_digit_loop

instrs.comment: Shift current 16-bit value left by 4 bits and accumulate new nibble
Store the parsed 16-bit result into CS:[01B2h], restore registers, and return
instrs.label: done
